scope: Freeze the first real verl Megatron plus vLLM training scene; no GPU run in Q21.

sources.finding: Official single-node eight-GPU Qwen3.5 35B MoE GRPO shape: Megatron TP2/EP8 and vLLM TP8; GDN uses padded BSHD and disables dynamic batching. The script uses vanilla mbridge compatibility mode.
The current universal CUDA 13 lock supplies the vLLM plus Megatron environment used by the selected source commit.
Official images include Megatron-LM, Apex and Transformer Engine; nightly source installation without dependencies is the documented development flow.
uv.cu130.dev3 and vllm024.dev2 exist. The README example vllm024.latest did not exist when resolved on 2026-09-08, so it was rejected.
Apache-2.0 model; official card documents vLLM use, TP8, text-only and MTP options. Q21 keeps BF16 and disables MTP to avoid an extra variable.
Official vLLM recipe identifies a 35B/3B-active MoE with 256 experts, vLLM minimum 0.17, BF16 and TP/TEP/DEP support. Runtime uses vLLM 0.24.0.
MIT, ungated, 7473 train and 1319 test rows; numeric final answers support verl's stock rule reward.
Modal supports up to eight same-machine B200 GPUs; requests above two GPUs can wait longer.
B200 price observed as USD 0.001736 per GPU-second; the registered 8 GPU by 2700 second hard cap is USD 37.4976.
Modal Image.from_id provides an immutable reusable image handle; Q21 pins the built dependency layer by image ID.

code_findings: No exact Qwen3.6 example name was found in verl main, so support is not claimed from naming alone.
Qwen3.6 config reports Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration and qwen3_5_moe; the active verl Megatron registry includes that architecture string.
Current verl main lock resolved torch 2.11.0+cu130, transformers 5.9.0, vLLM 0.24.0, Megatron-Core 0.18.0 and Megatron-Bridge 0.5.2 on Modal CPU.
The Megatron extra does not install flash-linear-attention; Q21 does not add it ad hoc because the selected Megatron path and lock are the object under test.
network_and_tool_failures: Local Hugging Face Dataset Viewer and direct Parquet downloads timed out; the exact revision was downloaded successfully in Modal CPU.

Git clone over the local route failed; codeload succeeded locally, but archive bytes differed on a later cloud fetch. The image build therefore verifies git rev-parse HEAD at the pinned commit instead of tar bytes.
The documented vllm024.latest example tag returned manifest unknown; a current published universal image was used and then frozen by Modal image ID.
decision: Proceed to Q22 with this one scene. A real eight-B200 load is still required before claiming end-to-end backend support or any performance baseline.
